nvitk.pipes.bbtpy¶

Black-blood (vwi_bb) pipeline package (nvitk-bbtpy).

Stages live in sibling modules (stage0_download, stage0_convert, stage1_registration, stage2_bb_segmentation). Shared defaults are in config; path and eICAB helpers are under util.
